visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontally scrolling cards with prev/next arrows
notes: Cream background; gold eyebrow and large intro sentence top-left, round next/prev arrow top-right; horizontally scrolling cards (tall image, title, short text, gold "Explore sector" arrow link).

contentPattern.structure: optional single-cell intro row (eyebrow + lead text); then one row per card: cell 1 = tall image, cell 2 = title + short text + arrow link
patterns: tall image + title + text + arrow link
blockContent: 4 sector cards (Mobility, Water, Energy, Tech and Digital), each image + title + text + Explore Sector link to sector detail page; horizontal slider with arrows

usage.description: Sector or category carousels of cards.

reuseGuidance: Use when cards overflow horizontally. Use cards for a static grid.
